card.name: Words before liquids and containers
card.fires_on: Small linking words or units right before a liquid, vehicle or container is named, such as 'of' after mL or ounces, or 'or' after glass. Mostly in preparation steps for suspensions and lab solutions.

modes.label: Volume then 'of'
modes.description: The word 'of' or 'mL' after an amount, just before the liquid to be added.
modes.example: Add 140 mL<< of>> Ora-Sweet ® SF into mortar

modes.label: Lab solution and container wording
modes.description: Opening bracket, percent sign or 'or' inside solvent and container descriptions.

modes.label: Other material-use phrases
modes.description: Verbs or 'of' before a substance in general text, such as paint or fluid.
modes.example: Jackson Pollock<< used>> gloss enamel because it poured and dripped

card.writes: No clear link to a single word, though it slightly favors odd name-like pieces and disfavors 'cap' words.
card.plain: It fires on the little word just before a liquid or material is named, as in 'add 100 mL of water'.
